summary: P2 1.10 -- selective high-impact configuration-change auditing. Admin saves and staff-facing config API calls across Hardware, Encoders, Monitoring, RBDS, Weather/AMBER, and Web Requests now emit privacy-safe, operator-attributed SystemEvents distinguishing saved state from runtime adoption, with sensitive fields redacted. Audit-only: no engine, monitoring, encoder, or RBDS runtime behavior changes, so only the web process needs the new code loaded.
